description: AICTIONBOT™ service catalogue by KULIC Advisory (tool 40), built on the Execution Toolkit template T23 (service level agreement). Without a list it writes a catalogue of 15 services in three levels (1 basics below the threshold, 2 quotes, negotiation and contracts for any value, 3 strategic from the threshold; default threshold 25,000 euros) with requester, response time, cycle time in working days, what the department must provide and the matching Workbench tool. With a list of the team's own services (service, level, for, from value, response time, cycle time) it checks gaps, duplicates and unrealistic times and names common services that are missing. Adds ground rules and a capacity note from the team size. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

response_days.description: Optional response time in working days for all services of the standard catalogue.

services.description: Optional own services: service, level (1 to 3), for, from_value, response (days), cycle (days).

team.description: Name of the team, e.g. Procurement.

threshold.description: Value in euros from which level 3 applies. Default 25000.

name: build_service_catalogue
title: Service catalogue for a procurement team: what it does for whom, from which value and how fast, in three levels
